outcome: willingness to participate in each trial design
cohort: 416 low-risk, nulliparous pregnant women and 168 healthcare providers
finding: Few women and professionals would participate in an RCT comparing planned delivery mode, while more favored PCTs or PRPPTs, highlighting limitations for each design and suggesting the need to consider alternative study designs.
mod_finding: This study focuses on planned mode of delivery, comparing cesarean section to vaginal delivery, and explores the feasibility of different trial designs to assess this choice in low-risk nulliparous women.
